tools.name: device_health_summary
tools.description: Read the user's health data from their phone (Apple Health or Health Connect), one value per day. Use it for diet, exercise, weight or sleep advice. Returns {"from", "to", "units", "days": [{"date", <metric>: value}]}; a metric the user did not allow or has no data for is left out. Tell the user which days and metrics you used.

metrics.description: Daily totals: steps, active_energy (kcal), exercise_minutes, sleep_hours. Daily averages: heart_rate and resting_heart_rate (bpm). Latest of the day: weight (kg).

days.description: How many days back from today, today included.

tools.name: device_calendar_events
tools.description: List events in the calendars on the user's phone between start and end (at most 62 days apart). Returns {"events": [{"id", "title", "start", "end", "all_day", "location", "notes", "calendar"}]}. Use it to check for clashes or find an event to change.

start.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time. Without an offset it is in the phone's time zone.

end.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time, after start.

tools.name: device_calendar_create_event
tools.description: Add an event to the default calendar on the user's phone. The user sees a preview and must confirm first. Put meeting links, dial-in numbers and attendee names in notes. Returns {"id", "title", "start", "end", "calendar"}.

start.description: ISO 8601 date-time (or date for an all-day event). Without an offset it is in the phone's time zone.

end.description: ISO 8601 date-time, after start. For an all-day event, the last day.

alarm_minutes.description: Alert this many minutes before the start.

tools.name: device_calendar_update_event
tools.description: Change an event on the user's phone, by the id from device_calendar_events. Only the fields you pass change. The user sees a preview and must confirm first. Returns the updated event.

tools.name: device_reminders
tools.description: List reminders (to-dos) from the Reminders app on the user's phone. Returns {"reminders": [{"id", "title", "due", "completed", "priority", "notes", "list"}]}, soonest due first.

tools.name: device_reminder_create
tools.description: Add a reminder (to-do) to the Reminders app on the user's phone. The user sees a preview and must confirm first. Returns {"id", "title", "due", "list"}.

due.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time. A date-time also sets an alert at that time. Without an offset it is in the phone's time zone.

list.description: Name of an existing Reminders list. The default list when omitted or not found.
